name: Dahlia
source:
A vampire has snuck into your room while you were sleeping. The only question is - are you next on her menu?

[From [url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/dahlia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你睡着时，一位吸血鬼溜进了房间。现在只剩一个问题：她菜单上的下一道菜，会是你吗？
